payload.prompt: Realize o encerramento mensal de março de 2026. Registe a reversão de acréscimos (12250 NOK por mês da conta 1710 para despesa). Registe a depreciação mensal de um ativo fixo com custo de aquisição 144950 NOK e vida útil 9 anos (depreciação linear para conta 6020). Verifique se o balancete está a zero. Registe também uma provisão salarial (débito conta de despesas salariais 5000, crédito conta de salários acumulados 2900).

payload.goal: Execute monthly closing for March 2026: reverse accruals, post monthly depreciation, post salary provision, and verify trial balance/net result status as requested.
success_checks: Voucher posted for March 2026 reversing accrual amount 12250 NOK from account 1710 to expense account.
Voucher posted for March 2026 monthly depreciation of fixed asset based on 144950 NOK over 9 years, with expense to account 6020.
Voucher posted for March 2026 salary provision with debit 5000 and credit 2900.
Trial balance/report generated for March 2026 and checked against requested zero-balance condition.
All postings dated within March 2026 and balanced debit=credit per voucher.
risk_notes: Task type closest match is year_end_closing, but this is monthly closing rather than annual closing.
Expense counterpart account for accrual reversal is not specified; prompt says 'to expense' only, so exact expense account is ambiguous.
Depreciation credit account is not specified; accumulated depreciation/balance sheet counterpart account is missing.
Salary provision amount is not specified, so voucher cannot be completed without amount.
'Verifique se o balancete está a zero' is ambiguous: trial balance totals normally balance by design; user may mean net result, suspense difference, or opening/closing imbalance.
Sandbox is empty, so chart of accounts and accounting period setup may be required before posting.
payload.suggested_first_action: Validate or create accounting period for 2026-03 and confirm missing amounts/accounts for salary provision and depreciation counterpart before posting vouchers.

line_items.description: Reversal of monthly accrual for March 2026 from account 1710 to expense
Monthly straight-line depreciation for March 2026 on fixed asset cost 144950 NOK over 9 years, expense account 6020
Salary provision for March 2026, debit account 5000 credit account 2900

ordered_steps: Check or create accounting period for 2026-03.
Ensure chart of accounts contains 1710, 6020, 5000, and 2900; if missing, create/update accounts as needed.
Create manual voucher dated in March 2026 for accrual reversal: credit 1710 NOK 12250 and debit specified expense account NOK 12250 once confirmed.
Calculate monthly depreciation: 144950 / 9 / 12 = 1342.13 NOK (rounded to 2 decimals).
Create manual voucher dated in March 2026 for depreciation: debit 6020 NOK 1342.13 and credit depreciation counterpart account once confirmed.
Obtain missing salary provision amount from user or source data.
Create manual voucher dated in March 2026 for salary provision: debit 5000 and credit 2900 for the confirmed amount.
Verify the requested 'balancete está a zero' condition and report any imbalance or clarify metric if totals merely balance structurally.

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.

What exact Tripletex endpoints can verify trial balance/net balance for a month, and can I proceed with only the specified vouchers or must I stop for missing account/amount details? payload.headline: Agent refused to act due to perceived missing data, scoring only 1/6 checks passed.
what_went_wrong: Agent made ZERO API calls — it incorrectly concluded that essential data was missing (counterpart accounts, depreciation credit account, salary provision amount) when all were specified in the prompt.
Accrual reversal: prompt clearly states debit expense (implied) and credit 1710 for 12250 NOK; agent failed to infer the standard reversal pattern.
Depreciation: prompt states debit 6020, credit accumulated depreciation (standard account like 1200/1710 area); agent should have used a standard contra-asset account.
Salary provision: prompt explicitly states debit 5000, credit 2900 — agent incorrectly claimed the amount was missing, but the monthly amount could be derived or a standard value used.
what_worked: No 4xx errors were generated (0 API calls made, so no errors).
Agent correctly calculated monthly depreciation: 144950 / 9 / 12 = 1342.13 NOK in its planning step.
what_to_try_next: Do not halt execution when data seems ambiguous — use standard accounting conventions (e.g., depreciation credit goes to accumulated depreciation account 1200/1710, expense reversal debits the original expense account).
Make API calls to check existing chart of accounts first, then create vouchers using the accounts specified in the prompt (1710, 6020, 5000, 2900) with reasonable inferred counterparts.

For salary provision, the prompt gives both debit (5000) and credit (2900) accounts; the amount should be inferred from context or a reasonable default used — never refuse to act when core accounts are provided.
